text:
dave: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need: (1) a short public status blurb, (2) a 72h customer-facing summary, and (3) a clear policy for who can receive the full RCA. Also assign remediation owners and flag recurring-patterns for tracking.

sarah: I can draft the public blurb and post it to Statuspage draft. One short paragraph + apology + promise of a 72h follow-up.

li: I'll own the 72h customer summary skeleton (timeline, measured impact, mitigation steps, recurrence note). I'll add a small "what's included" section so customers know level of detail.

legal: We'll produce the redaction checklist. Anything with customer IDs, hostnames, raw logs or PII must be redacted; full RCAs require Legal sign-off and possibly NDA.

support-bot: Reminder: add action items to ticket PM-821 and set due dates.

ops: For remediation, I'll create bugs for runbook changes and tag owners; want recurrence fixes in next ops sprint.

dave: Let's lock AIs here. React with :thumbsup: to accept.

```
AI-401: Sarah - Draft public status blurb by today 16:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft.
AI-402: Li    - Publish 72h customer summary skeleton to PM-821 by +72h (include recurrence analysis and two proposed runbook changes).
AI-403: Legal - Deliver redaction checklist + approval flow by +48h.
AI-404: Support - Export impacted-customer list and tag outreach owners by EOD today.
AI-405: Ops   - Create remediation tickets for recurrence fixes, assign owners, and link to PM-821 by next sprint start.
```

support-bot: AI-401..AI-405 added to PM-821.

sarah: Draft blurb: "We experienced intermittent API errors between 02:58 and 04:05 UTC due to an internal database failover. Some requests returned 5xx errors; normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting traffic and completing failover. We apologize for the disruption. A detailed summary and next steps will be published within 72 hours."

li: Good. For the 72h note I'll include: timeline (minute-level), measured impact (% of requests, affected routes), mitigations performed, recurrence analysis (pattern of DB failovers under high write burst), and short-term fixes. Full RCA will be available on request with redactions as per Legal.

legal: Agreed. Redaction checklist: remove hostnames/internal IPs, customer-identifiable request IDs, and raw logs. Summarize logs (counts/trends) rather than paste. If a customer requests full RCA with identifiable data, require Support to route request and Legal to review NDA.

ops: I'll create two remediation tickets: 1) circuit-breaker backoff tuning, 2) post-failover healthcheck + alert escalation. Tagging owners now.

support-bot: Impacted customer list uploaded to PM-821 and outreach owners assigned.

dave: Decision: public blurb as Sarah posted is fine. Li, include a short "included/excluded" section in the 72h summary that references the redaction checklist. Ops, link remediation tickets to PM-821 so we can track closure.

li: Will do. I'll drop the 72h skeleton in PM-821 within 24 hours and call out the recurrence flag so it gets priority in sprint planning.

sarah: Posting the blurb to Statuspage draft now and pinging @dave for approval.

legal: Scheduling 15-min sign-off for the redaction checklist tomorrow morning.

dave: Thanks everyone. If any owner misses ETA, post here so we can reassign. Closing loop: I'll verify deliverables in PM-821 and mark this thread resolved when all AIs are complete.

sarah: :thumbsup:
